title: Recommendation Record
$comment: New core object, V2 Phase 1 (BL-011, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). A proposed action or decision, downstream of an Assessment and/or Signal -- the other missing link in the Recommendation -> Assessment/Signal -> Facts -> Evidence -> Source lineage chain (docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md, 'Recommendation'). NOT the same object as evidence.priority: Evidence Priority is a triage signal on one Evidence item ('how urgently should an analyst look at this?'); Recommendation is a decision/action proposal anchored on accumulated, interpreted intelligence ('what should we actually do?'). Per D-011 (docs/v2/08-DECISION-LOG.md, ACCEPTED) these coexist permanently and are never mechanically converted into each other. action_type is a free string, not an enum, deliberately: the actual vocabulary of recommendation types is domain-specific (docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md) and does not belong hard-coded in this core schema (D-007). No workspace/domain scoping fields yet -- Phase 3 (D-008).

action_type.$comment: Free string, not an enum -- the vocabulary belongs to a Domain Pack (e.g. a Berries starter set: pursue_licensing_discussion, escalate_to_commercial_review, monitor_for_confirmation, no_action_warranted), not this core schema. See docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md 'Recommendation'.

priority.$comment: How urgently this proposed ACTION should be acted on -- a single scalar on the recommendation itself. Not the same structure or purpose as evidence.priority's four fixed triage dimensions (reading/testing/commercial_position/monitoring) on an Evidence item; deliberately does not reuse that shape (D-011).
